description: Discover this spectacular 300 sqm penthouse featuring a 270 sqm rooftop terrace, jacuzzi, and direct views of the Eiffel Tower. A truly rare property in the heart of Paris’ prestigious 7th arrondissement, ideal for an exclusive stay or private event for up to 8 guests, combining elegance, comfort, and high-end amenities. Enjoy a unique Parisian experience with family or friends in this exceptional residence.The spaceDiscover an exceptional 300 sqm penthouse located on the top floor of a magnificent Haussmann-style building with a private elevator. Enjoy an incredible 270 sqm rooftop featuring a jacuzzi and a direct panoramic view of the Eiffel Tower for a truly unique and unforgettable Parisian experience. Its spectacular volumes and high-end amenities make it a rare setting to stay, entertain, or host a private event (upon request). The cathedral-style living room, enhanced by a monumental glass roof, is flooded with natural light and perfectly suited for both relaxation and entertaining. A grand piano, designer furniture, smart TV, integrated sound system, air conditioning, and curated artwork create an elegant and welcoming atmosphere. The fully equipped kitchen is ideal for cooking in a convivial setting or hosting a private caterer. The penthouse features 4 elegant suites, each with its own private bathroom, designed to combine comfort, privacy, and refinement. Every bedroom is equipped with a high-quality double bed, built-in storage, and a warm atmosphere conducive to relaxation. The master suite also benefits from a private jacuzzi on its terrace. The property includes a total of 6 modern bathrooms. One features a jacuzzi bathtub, while another offers a sauna/hammam area.
